component.name: Agent Session Manager
component.summary: Manage and resume your AI coding agent sessions

description.p: A native terminal workspace for AI coding-agent CLIs such as Claude Code and Cursor. Run agents side by side in spaces, tabs, and split panes, see at a glance which one is working, blocked, or done, and resume any past session from a searchable history.

ul.li: Spaces per project folder, with per-space tabs and split panes
Agent states: working, blocked, done, or idle, with notifications
A Ctrl+B prefix for panes, tabs, spaces, and a go-to-agent picker
Session history grouped by project, with favorites, search, and live updates
Session details: message counts, models, token usage
Catppuccin terminal-workspace look with theme variants, or classic Adwaita

description.p: Unofficial community tool — not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic. The agents' own session data is never modified.
Terminal workspace: spaces, agent states, split panes, and a Ctrl+B prefix.

ul.li: Spaces per project folder with per-space tabs and an agents list
Agent states (working / blocked / done / idle) with notifications
Split panes and a Ctrl+B prefix with a go-to-agent picker
Catppuccin terminal-workspace look with theme variants; classic style kept
Foldable, switchable sidebar sections and a tab emoji picker

description.p: Native chat, session replay, and richer session management.

ul.li: Native streaming chat with token-by-token output
Interactive permission cards (Allow / Always allow / Deny) for tool use
Cursor chat in read-only and trusted modes
Resume any session into a chat tab
Session replay: step through a transcript as native bubbles
Interactive prompt cards over the terminal
Advanced new-session flags: model, permission mode, extra directories, continue
Open a session from a transcript file; permanent delete; folder path in the sidebar
New generic agent icon and banner
UI translations: Hungarian, German, Spanish, French
Selectable terminal color themes
Multiple windows
Interrupted-session badge
AUR and Ubuntu PPA packages
Waiting badge for sessions where Claude asked a question
Export a session transcript as Markdown
Now on PyPI: pipx install claude-session-manager-gtk
Quick switcher (Ctrl+Shift+K) to jump to any session
New Session remembers your last folder; resizable sidebar
Read-only MCP servers browser
Drag to reorder tabs
Transcript peek: recent messages in the session details
Desktop notifications when a background session goes idle
MCP servers and per-session MCP usage in the details dialog
Online documentation site
Set a per-tab emoji prefix from the tab menu
Shift+Enter inserts a newline in Claude's prompt
Clearer active-tab styling and a close-all-tabs button

description.p: Search, graceful close, and sidebar polish.

ul.li: Find bar inside each terminal tab (Ctrl+Shift+G)
Closing a tab asks Claude to exit cleanly (/exit) in the background
Copy session ID from the tab menu
Groups collapsed by default; session rows styled as cards
Renameable tabs and per-tab status dots
Toggleable sidebar with a status footer
Confirmation before closing a tab with a running command
Installable .deb package
